envelope.description: Wire the bugfix deps through the adapter

body.title: Wire the bugfix deps through the adapter
body.summary: Change defaultTrackerCreateDeps and defaultTrackerCloseDeps, keeping their optional opts and the TrackerCreateDeps and TrackerCloseDeps interfaces, so createIssue keeps returning CreatedIssue, linkSubIssue keeps taking the numeric child id and throwing on failure, closeIssue throws on failure and findByLabels maps a failed lookup to undefined.
acceptanceChecks: createBugfixTrackerIssue still passes created.id to linkSubIssue and a readonly string[] of labels type-checks
A failed link makes linkToParent return false and a failed close propagates instead of returning status closed
The relink-by-label recovery records, closes through issueOps.close and returns closed on a match, and returns skipped for no labels, no match and a failed lookup
Both factories accept the optional labels and promptOnLostRef as before

tests.name: src/workflow/__tests__/bugfix-tracker.test.ts: bugfix create keeps CreatedIssue, readonly labels and the parent link through the adapter
src/workflow/__tests__/bugfix-tracker.test.ts: a failed link makes linkToParent return false and a failed close propagates instead of reporting closed
src/workflow/__tests__/bugfix-tracker.test.ts: relink-by-label match is recorded, closed and returned as closed
src/workflow/__tests__/bugfix-tracker.test.ts: relink-by-label with no labels, no match and a failed lookup returns skipped and never creates an issue
src/workflow/__tests__/bugfix-tracker.test.ts: both default deps factories keep their optional opts
